question_record.context: During a recent security incident, an alert was triggered when the user Luciano Herrera (pwilson@niseko.alpineskihouse.co) performed an unusual addition of credentials to the application SimulandApp. This suspect activity may indicate a potential compromise aimed at spreading phishing, data exfiltration, or unauthorized access. Following this, Luciano Herrera (CIO) initiated a suspicious directory services replication request from one machine to another.
question_record.question: While investigating further into this incident, can you identify the hostname associated with the activity where the DKM key of an ADFS object was accessed?
solution: There was an unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app by the account with SID `S-1-5-21-551436448-9871687716-9837441745-1903` (`Luciano Herrera`).
A suspected DCSync attack was performed by Luciano Herrera (CIO) from `MB-WINCLIENT` to the host `MB-DC1`.
The host `MB-DC1` read the DKM key of ADFS object id `4cac49d3-29d3-407e-8c9b-b7ebb21541b2`.

108.name: Unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app
108.description: The user Luciano Herrera (pwilson@niseko.alpineskihouse.co) performed an unusual addition of credentials to the application SimulandApp. This usage pattern may indicate that an attacker has compromised the app, and is using it to spread phishing, exfiltrate data, or to gain access to other accounts and devices. The user added a credential of type Password. A credential of type Password is added when an application is using a password to authenticate.

98.name: Suspected DCSync attack (replication of directory services)
98.description: Luciano Herrera (CIO) on MB-WINCLIENT sent 1 replication request to MB-DC1.

105.name: Suspected AD FS DKM key read
105.description: MB-DC1 read the DKM key of ADFS object id 4cac49d3-29d3-407e-8c9b-b7ebb21541b2

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Cloud_App_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
